verdict.rationale: Devin supports Slack/Teams tagging and interactive takeover (IDE, browser, terminal) which implies some in-context notification/interaction touchpoints, and scheduling with 'notification preferences' is mentioned for MCP-driven schedules, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated notification system (email/push/Slack alerts) for task completion or need-for-input across the main product. missing for 10: explicit completion/needs-input notification documentation outside scheduling context, independent confirmation of notification reliability, coverage across all interfaces (API, web app, CLI) rather than just Slack/Teams and MCP scheduling.
